input.text: Only the branch manager can approve an exception to the identification requirements.

input.text: Staff collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account. Staff may collect one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.
sources: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.
